title: Release Notify Config (release-notify/v1)
description: XACA-1342 / spec docs/release-workflow/RELEASE-LIFECYCLE.md § 11.4. Aliases resolved from the calling team's notify.json; secretRef is never a literal value (§ 2.2, § 11.4).

aliases.description: Keyed by alias name (e.g. 'cr-approver', 'release-channel'). At least one alias required.

provider.description: § 10.1: teams (HTTP flow / incoming webhook) first; slack, sms, email later, behind the same interface.

target.description: Never a literal destination (URL/number) -- always a secretRef (§ 2.2, § 11.4).

secretRef.description: vault:<engine_slug>/<account_slug> or env:<VAR_NAME> only. A literal value is a validation error.
